title: Web3 Data Hub
tagline: WEB3 DATA HUB is a place to pull or store datasets or ML models in one line commend. Its a hub that store datasets or models in decentralised way.
description:
Solution-

WEB3 DATA HUB is a common solution, using that people can easliy pull and push data / ML models. Generalized platform to users to get data/model in single click. (For Devlopers) python based pip package that fetch data in single call. Decentralized storage ( data + IPFS hashs)

IPFS + FEVM - 


Wallaby Network deployed contract - 0xEFb6C75B977f3D7A4b76A013850892e2D0fa8B03

IPFS ( NFT.storage and WEB3.storage ) that used to store the high volume data's and Wallaby testnet that used to store and map the IPFS hashes with authorization mechanism. If user to want push some data to our hub, they need to pass some authorization tests to ensure the data/model is clean and not malformed.

Both data and hash's are completely decentralized.
